summary: Single-purpose automation that books a Deskbird desk 7 days in advance using headless Chromium/Selenium, Microsoft SSO, and 1Password-CLI credentials. Almost all behaviour lives in one linear script (deskbird_booking.py) that is packaged as a container and run as a Kubernetes CronJob in the 'automation' namespace of the firefly cluster, deployed via Kustomize + SOPS and reconciled by Flux.
entrypoints: deskbird_booking.py:<module>  (linear script, no main(); container CMD runs it)

booking_script.purpose: End-to-end booking: read env config, fetch creds + TOTP from 1Password, drive Chromium through Deskbird login + Microsoft SSO, then book a desk 7 days out (preferred desk first, else any available).

container.purpose: python:3.11-slim + chromium + chromium-driver + 1password-cli + selenium; CMD python deskbird_booking.py.

k8s_base.purpose: CronJob spec: schedule 'Mon & Thu 01:00 Europe/Amsterdam' (spec.timeZone set — required to avoid wrong-day bookings), env from deskbird-credentials secret including BOOKING_WEEKDAYS and BOOKING_TIMEZONE, resource limits, backoffLimit/activeDeadlineSeconds, in-memory /dev/shm volume.

k8s_prod_overlay.purpose: Prod Kustomize overlay: base + SOPS/age-encrypted secret (secret.enc.yaml); pins the image tag via kustomize 'images' (auto-bumped by the Flux imagepolicy annotation).

ci_release.purpose: build-release.yaml runs semantic-release on push to main/staging (skips md/gitignore/LICENSE). container-image-release.yaml builds+pushes the multi-arch (amd64+arm64) GHCR image via docker-bake when a release is published.

callgraph_highlights.note: Runs top-to-bottom at import; exits 0 early (before Chrome/cred fetch) if target weekday not in BOOKING_WEEKDAYS. RAISES immediately if OFFICE_ID or FLOOR_ID env vars are unset, or if BOOKING_TIMEZONE is invalid.
is_authenticated_url gates progress past the transient /sign-in/landing + /authenticationHandler pages; loosening it re-introduces the OAuth-callback race that broke every run.
Books via data-testid='booking-suggestions-quick-book'; Deskbird orders suggestions favourite-first, so the first button is the preferred desk when available.
